SIHF Event timeline of one game

Source: R/sihf.R
sihf_pbp.Rd

Event timeline of one game: goals, penalties, goaltender changes, revoked goals and shootout attempts.

Reads the Swiss Ice Hockey Federation statistics API (data.sihf.ch, keyless JSON). SIHF keys a season by its END year (2026 = 2025-26). An unknown season, league_id or phase_id is never an error upstream (SIHF silently answers another one), so every table answer is checked against the body's own filter echo and refused when it differs. Every request is spaced at least one second from the last one to the host.

Usage

sihf_pbp(game_id, language = "en")

Arguments

game_id

Required. SIHF game id (game_id in sihf_results), e.g. 20261105000325.

language

Response language. Only part of the body is translated: status, position and penalty names stay German.

Value

A fastRhockey_data tibble with 34 columns. A zero-row tibble with these columns when the payload holds no rows.

col_nametypedescription
game_idnumericSIHF game id (numeric join key; the details link of sihf_results, the searchQuery of the game wrappers).
event_indexinteger1-based event order within the game.
period_numberinteger1-based period (4 = first overtime); the shootout follows the last period.
periodcharacterPeriod name as SIHF prints it, German (e.g., "1. Drittel", "Shootout").
event_typecharacterEvent kind: "goal", "penalty", "goalie", "revoked_goal" or "shootout".
timecharacterElapsed game time of the event, "mm:ss" (null on shootout rows).
game_secondsintegerElapsed game time of the event in seconds.
team_idintegerSIHF team id of the team the event belongs to.
team_sidecharacterSide of the game the row belongs to: "home" or "away".
player_idintegerLicence number of the scorer, penalized player, goaltender (goalie rows) or shooter.
player_namecharacterName of the scorer, penalized player, goaltender (goalie rows) or shooter.
player_jerseyintegerJersey number of the player in player_id.
assist1_player_idintegerLicence number of the first assist.
assist1_player_namecharacterName of the first assist.
assist2_player_idintegerLicence number of the second assist.
assist2_player_namecharacterName of the second assist.
goalie_idintegerLicence number of the goaltender faced (shootout rows).
goalie_namecharacterName of the goaltender faced (shootout rows).
strengthcharacterFirst goal tag: "EQ" even strength, "PP1" power play, "SH1" shorthanded, ...
goal_tagscharacterEvery goal tag, comma-joined as SIHF prints them (e.g., "PP1,GWG").
score_homeintegerHome score after the goal.
score_awayintegerAway score after the goal.
plus_player_idslistLicence numbers credited +1 on the goal (listed only where plus-minus applies).
minus_player_idslistLicence numbers charged -1 on the goal (listed only where plus-minus applies).
penalty_idintegerSIHF penalty-type id.
penalty_namecharacterPenalty name, German whatever the language (e.g., "Haken").
penalty_minutesintegerPenalty length in minutes.
penalty_startcharacterGame time the penalty starts, "mm:ss".
penalty_endcharacterGame time the penalty ended, "mm:ss" (earlier than its full length when a goal ended it).
goalie_changecharacterGoaltender change direction: "in" or "out".
revoke_reasoncharacterWhy the goal was disallowed, as SIHF prints it (e.g., "CC-Offiside").
shootout_numberinteger1-based shootout attempt number.
shootout_scoredlogicalWhether the shootout attempt scored.
textcharacterEvent text exactly as SIHF prints it (markdown bold included).

Errors

  • fastRhockey_no_data: SIHF answered 404 (unknown game), or ignored a requested season, league or phase and served another one.

  • fastRhockey_bad_request: SIHF answered 400 / 422, or an argument is invalid.

  • fastRhockey_asset_fetch: any other non-2xx answer or a dead connection after retries, an empty or unreadable body, a stub or redirect body, a table without its filter echo, a truncated table, or a gameoverview body for another game.
